info.description: # alltradingapi Python client for the [All Trading API](https://alltradingapi.com) — candles, assets, saved candles, candle history, chart images and trade result checks for Quotex. - Zero dependencies, standard library only - Sync and async clients - Typed, ships `py.typed` - Automatic retries on rate limits and server errors - Python 3.10+ | | | |---|---| | [![PyPI](https://img.shields.io/pypi/v/alltradingapi)](https://pypi.org/project/alltradingapi/) | [![Python](https://img.shields.io/pypi/pyversions/alltradingapi)](https://pypi.org/project/alltradingapi/) | | [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)](LICENSE) | | ## Install ``` pip install alltradingapi ``` Get an API key from [alltradingapi.com](https://alltradingapi.com). Each endpoint type has its own key. The simplest setup is one default key: ``` export ATA_API_KEY=ap_yourkey ``` You can also pass keys per product, or per call — see [authentication](#authentication). ## Quickstart ```python from alltradingapi import Client with Client() as ata: # uses ATA_API_KEY assets = ata.assets(only_open=True) print("open assets:", len(assets)) candles = ata.candles("EURUSD_otc", hours=2, timeframe="1m") print("last close:", candles[-1].close) ``` ## Endpoints | method | endpoint | returns | |---|---|---| | `ata.assets()` | `/qx_assets` | list of assets with open state and payouts | | `ata.candles(asset)` | `/qx_candles` | current candles (OHLC) | | `ata.history(asset)` | `/qx_history` | candle history | | `ata.saved(asset)` | `/qx_saved` | saved candles from the archive | | `ata.screenshot(asset)` | `/qx_ss_pro_v2` | chart image as PNG bytes | | `ata.result(asset, time, direction)` | `/qx_result` | trade result check | Common options: `timeframe` (`5s`…`4h`), `timezone` (`"-3"`, `"UTC"`, `"Asia/Dhaka"`, …), `hours` (1–24), `count` (1–1000 for saved candles). Invalid values raise `ValidationError` before any request is sent. ## Saving a chart image ```python png = ata.screenshot("EURUSD_otc", timeframe="1m") with open("chart.png", "wb") as f: f.write(png) # real PNG, 1200x680, returned by the API ``` ## Result check ```python outcome = ata.result("EURUSD_otc", time="20:00", direction="call", mtg=1) print(outcome.result) # TradeOutcome.WIN / LOSE / REFUND / PENDING / ... ``` ## Async ```python import asyncio from alltradingapi import AsyncClient async def main(): async with AsyncClient() as ata: assets = await ata.assets(only_open=True) symbols = [a.symbol for a in assets if a.is_otc][:10] # candles for many assets at once; failures stay per-asset results = await ata.scan(symbols, hours=1) for symbol, candles in results.items(): if not isinstance(candles, Exception): print(symbol, len(candles), "candles") asyncio.run(main()) ``` ## Authentication Keys are sent as a bearer header by default. Resolution order: 1. per-call `api_key=...` 2. `Client(keys={"quotex-candles": "ap_..."})` 3. `Client(keys={"default": "ap_..."})` 4. `Client(api_key="ap_...")` 5. `ATA_API_KEY` environment variable 6. per-product `ATA_KEY_QUOTEX_CANDLES`, `ATA_KEY_QUOTEX_ASSETS`, etc. Use `auth_mode="query"` if you prefer `?key=` in the URL instead. ## Errors and retries 429 and 5xx responses are retried automatically with backoff, honouring `Retry-After`. After the retries are exhausted you get a specific exception: ```python from alltradingapi.errors import ( ALLError, AuthenticationError, PermissionDeniedError, RateLimitError, ValidationError, UpstreamError, ) try: candles = ata.candles("EURUSD_otc") except RateLimitError as e: print("slow down, retry after", e.retry_after, "s") except ValidationError as e: print("bad parameter:", e.message) except UpstreamError: print("feed is down, try again later") ``` Every error carries `.status`, `.message`, `.payload` and a redacted `.url`. ## Staying up to date The client checks PyPI once per process and refuses to run if a newer version exists, unless you opt out: ```python ata = Client(update_policy="warn") # strict (default) | ask | warn | off ``` Escape hatches: `ATA_UPDATE_POLICY=off`, `ATA_SKIP_UPDATE=1`, `Client(allow_outdated=True)`. Check without gating: `ata.check_updates(force=True)`. ## More examples See the [examples/](examples/) folder: quickstart, candle history with a sparkline, and chart images with async scanning. ## License & disclaimer MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). © 2026 All Trading API. Independent, unofficial API. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Quotex. Trading involves substantial risk. This SDK provides market data only — it cannot place trades and is not financial advice.
